authoritative_source: Raw LabelMe float geometry for IRF/SRF/ELM/EZ/HF
conventional_mask_source: Released Image_Seg masks retained only for conventional semantic-segmentation benchmark reproduction/comparison

anatomical_order_constraint.condition: columns where both ELM and EZ are present/valid
anatomical_order_constraint.loss: hinge/ReLU ordering penalty; no fixed anatomical separation imposed

column_presence.meaning: whether ELM/EZ is annotated/identifiable in that column

column_y_distribution.multiple_levels: multi-peak target permitted in rare ambiguous columns
column_y_distribution.supervision: normalized vertical Gaussian distribution, only on present columns

pathology_preservation_policy.gap_modeling: column-presence prediction explicitly models visible/annotated gaps
pathology_preservation_policy.reason: EZ rupture/discontinuity can be pathological and explicitly occurs in the dataset annotation protocol. The model must not be forced to bridge true gaps.

centerline_heatmap.description: Gaussian proximity map generated from authoritative float curves on annotated columns only

vertical_distance_field.description: per-column unsigned vertical distance to nearest valid curve level
vertical_distance_field.loss_validity: only columns covered by an authoritative curve annotation

curves.validity_mask: native FOV; no ELM/EZ raw coordinate was observed outside native FOV

malformed_annotation_policy: Retain the image and exclude only the malformed individual primary annotation, matching geometry_v1.
name: RVO-ME Geometry-Aware Target Protocol v2

points.label: HF

target.gaussian_composition: pixelwise maximum, preserving multiple nearby peaks
target.offset: two-channel local fractional x/y offset from heatmap cell to authoritative float coordinate

points.validity_mask: native FOV; no valid HF center was observed outside native FOV

regions.auxiliary_target: one-pixel class-specific region boundary maps derived from the padded region masks

oob_annotation_policy.interpretation: All are region vertices. Maximum right-boundary excursion is 0; they reach the continuous x=570 boundary but do not extend beyond it.

regions.primary_target: two binary region masks rasterized from valid raw geometry on 576x384

rasterization.linestrip_with_at_least_3_points: closed filled region, matching validated geometry_v1 policy
rasterization.malformed_shape_policy: exclude malformed individual annotation only; retain image

regions.semantic_relation: The final region classifier is mutually exclusive at inference: background/SRF/IRF.

validity_masks.region_boundary_auxiliary_loss: native FOV plus annotation-supported right-boundary padding where a raw IRF/SRF vertex lies exactly on the continuous x=570 image boundary
